description: Defines classes and interfaces for managing audio ports and configurations in Android's media framework, including AudioPort and AudioPortConfig classes with methods for handling audio port properties, gains, profiles, and parcelable serialization.

classes.name: AudioPort
classes.description: Represents an audio port with properties such as name, type, role, gains, profiles, and descriptors, providing methods for serialization, profile management, and port configuration.

classes.name: AudioPortConfig
classes.description: Represents configuration for an audio port, including sampling rate, format, channel mask, ID, gain, and flags, with methods for applying and serializing configurations.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the audio port.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the audio port.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the audio port.

methods.name: getRole
methods.description: Returns the role of the audio port.

methods.name: setFlags
methods.description: Sets the flags for the audio port.

methods.name: getFlags
methods.description: Returns the current flags of the audio port.

methods.name: setGains
methods.description: Sets the gain controllers for the port.

methods.name: getGains
methods.description: Returns the gain controllers of the port.

methods.name: toAudioPort
methods.description: Serializes the port to an audio_port structure.

methods.name: addAudioProfile
methods.description: Adds an audio profile to the port.

methods.name: clearAudioProfiles
methods.description: Clears all audio profiles from the port.

methods.name: hasValidAudioProfile
methods.description: Checks if the port has a valid audio profile.

methods.name: hasDynamicAudioProfile
methods.description: Checks if the port has a dynamic audio profile.

methods.name: setAudioProfiles
methods.description: Sets multiple audio profiles for the port.

methods.name: getAudioProfiles
methods.description: Returns the audio profiles associated with the port.

methods.name: setExtraAudioDescriptors
methods.description: Sets extra audio descriptors for the port.

methods.name: getExtraAudioDescriptors
methods.description: Returns extra audio descriptors.

methods.name: importAudioPort
methods.description: Imports properties from another AudioPort object.

methods.name: importAudioPort
methods.description: Imports properties from an audio_port_v7 structure.

methods.name: checkGain
methods.description: Checks if a gain configuration is valid for a specific gain controller.

methods.name: useInputChannelMask
methods.description: Determines if input channel mask should be used based on port type and role.

methods.name: isDirectOutput
methods.description: Checks if the port is a direct output.

methods.name: isMmap
methods.description: Checks if the port supports MMAP.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs a string representation of the port for debugging.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs port information.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Compares this port with another for equality.

methods.name: writeToParcelable
methods.description: Serializes the port to a parcelable object.

methods.name: readFromParcelable
methods.description: Deserializes the port from a parcelable object.

methods.name: getAudioPort
methods.description: Returns the associated AudioPort object.

methods.name: applyAudioPortConfig
methods.description: Applies a new audio port configuration.

methods.name: toAudioPortConfig
methods.description: Serializes the configuration to an audio_port_config structure.

methods.name: getSamplingRate
methods.description: Returns the sampling rate.

methods.name: getFormat
methods.description: Returns the audio format.

methods.name: getChannelMask
methods.description: Returns the channel mask.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the port handle ID.

methods.name: getFlags
methods.description: Returns the port flags.

methods.name: hasGainController
methods.description: Checks if the port has a gain controller available.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if this configuration equals another.

methods.name: writeToParcelable
methods.description: Serializes the configuration to a parcelable.

methods.name: readFromParcelable
methods.description: Deserializes the configuration from a parcelable.
